name: Shield
notes: Standard is the shipped Figma artwork. Outline and Filled are derived here — Outline strokes each shape and fills it with the knockout colour so overlapping shapes still occlude; Filled treats everything but near-white detail as the body. Both are drawn in currentColor and take an accent. REVIEW (Filled only): the checkmark is lost — it is drawn in the same tint as the bell body elsewhere in the set, so no single threshold keeps both. Outline and Standard are unaffected. Needs a drawn reduction before this leaves draft.
